candidates.change_summary: Remove the balance update to keep it unchanged despite decreasing credit, causing balance mismatch and preventing subsequent withdrawals.
Remove the credit zeroing so the caller retains credit after withdrawal, allowing repeated withdrawals of the same credit.
Remove the external call that actually sends Ether, so the sender never receives funds but still loses their credit.
Remove the if-guard so that withdrawAll always executes the body, causing balance underflow and a failing call on zero credit.
